files.plugins/sounds/README.md:
# sounds

A plugin that plays OS-native sound alerts on events like task completion and notifications. Supports macOS and Linux.

## Install

### Claude Code

```bash
claude plugin marketplace add derogab/agent-kit
claude plugin install sounds@agent-kit
```
